comment: The sounds tools/fetch_audio.py fetches: files and archives (zip, 7z, rar) at fixed URLs or itch.io uploads; the files picked from under `root` by pattern are prepared by their kind (targets: loudness in LUFS, true-peak ceiling in dBTP, channels, format, Vorbis quality) and written to <dest>, cc0/ or ccby/ by licence. sfx: trimmed mono WAV; loop, music, jingle: stereo Ogg; mono: an Ogg as mono WAV (Kenney's placeholders); keep: as it is. Optional per item: cut [start, end] s, max s (a long ring cut short), limit dB (a limiter may take that much off the peaks), split (takes cut at silences), seam s (a loop's crossfade), declick ms (a loop's ends faded, its length kept), gain dB, rename; each a value or a map by file. mixes: ambience beds made of layers (sources by id). credit: what CREDITS.md says. audio.lock.json records each download's sha256.
